source.why: Our own ball_v1 (yolov8s, trained on the 6 bundled Roboflow ball datasets) detects the ball in only ~2-16% of real broadcast frames. Retraining on the same data 4x38 epochs made real-world performance WORSE (overfit to close-up Roboflow images). This external YOLO11n checkpoint is trained for broadcast-view ball detection and generalises to our footage. Kept the old checkpoint at runs/_eval/ball_OLD_leaky.pt.

real_clip_eval.note: fraction of stride-sampled frames with at least one ball detection at conf=0.10, imgsz=1280; not mAP
